stories.title: US, Japan, South Korea hold urgent talks after North Korean missile barrage
stories.description: Senior diplomats coordinated their response Friday after Pyongyang fired about 10 ballistic missiles, dismissing Trump's scaled-back military drills.

stories.title: Iran's Pezeshkian calls for end to US war from 'position of strength'
stories.description: The Iranian president defended a June deal with Washington as the US pivoted to what it called the "toughest sanctions in history."

stories.title: US, Canada race to finalize trade deal before Saturday tariff deadline
stories.description: Negotiators are working through Friday in Washington as 50% tariffs on $20 billion in Canadian goods are set to take effect at 12:01 a.m. ET Saturday.

stories.title: White House furor over Natalie Harp intensifies after week of damaging leaks
stories.description: A pointed remark by Sen. Jon Ossoff about Trump's ever-present aide spiraled into a national story after the West Wing's aggressive pushback backfired.

stories.title: Vance says US moving up to 15M barrels daily through Hormuz despite Iran blockade
stories.description: The vice president said a military-protected shipping corridor is preventing the energy crisis Iran is trying to create.

stories.title: Ukraine asks Musk to allow Starlink strikes deep into Russia
stories.description: Kyiv wants to use Starlink-equipped drones to hit Russian missile launchers up to 200 km inside Russia amid a critical Patriot shortage.

stories.title: Trump admin moves to strip ABA of law school accreditation power
stories.description: The Education Department is beginning formal proceedings to revoke the ABA's authority as the sole accreditor of the nation's law schools.

stories.title: New York Times ordered to pay $9.25M in landmark defamation verdict
stories.description: An Alabama jury found the Times defamed former walk-on player Kai Spears, marking the paper's first U.S. defamation trial loss in over 50 years.

stories.title: Hong Kong convicts Tiananmen vigil leaders of subversion
stories.description: Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung were found guilty of inciting subversion for advocating an end to one-party rule in China. They face up to 10 years in prison.

stories.title: Trump withholds mandated 2024 election interference report
stories.description: The administration has released hundreds of pages of other declassified material while keeping the congressionally required foreign interference assessment secret.

stories.title: Somali pirates seize 2 ships in 4 days as hijackings hit decade high
stories.description: Six ships and over 100 crew members are now held captive as naval forces stretched by Middle East conflicts leave Somali waters less patrolled.

stories.title: USS Abraham Lincoln heads home after record 272 days at sea
stories.description: The George Washington arrived Wednesday to relieve the Lincoln, whose crew endured supply shortages and mental health crises during the Iran war.

stories.title: Trump joins Michael Cohen's radio show in public reunion
stories.description: Cohen, the star witness in Trump's 2024 hush money trial, hosted the president on his WABC program after months of quiet reconciliation.

stories.title: Wahab wins California special election despite AIPAC spending
stories.description: State Sen. Aisha Wahab defeated Melissa Hernandez to fill Rep. Eric Swalwell's vacated House seat, overcoming millions in outside spending.

stories.title: First U.S. deportation flight lands in Liberia under new deal
stories.description: Twenty migrants arrived Thursday as part of a pact allowing up to 1,200 third-country deportees to be sent to the West African nation.

stories.title: Navy weighs renaming carrier honoring Black WWII hero after Trump
stories.description: The Ford-class carrier CVN-81, designated USS Doris Miller during Trump's first term, may become the first carrier named for a sitting president.

stories.title: Seven nations urge Israel to withdraw E1 settlement tenders
stories.description: The UK summoned Israel's chargé d'affaires and joined six other Western governments in calling the West Bank construction plan "unacceptable."

stories.title: Anthropic aims to match or top SpaceX's record IPO
stories.description: The Claude developer filed a confidential S-1 with the SEC and could go public as soon as late August, according to Bloomberg.

stories.title: DHS could identify only 185 of 16,000 alleged noncitizen voters in Nevada
stories.description: The Trump administration's sweeping claims of illegal voter registration are unraveling as federal agencies fail to substantiate the president's assertions ahead of the midterms.

stories.title: FBI arrests woman in ISIS-inspired plot to bomb N.Y. Capitol
stories.description: Jessica Bowie, 35, of Albany was charged with planning to deploy an explosive at the state Capitol to kill lawmakers, the DOJ said.

stories.title: China builds 'unprecedented' maritime presence east of Taiwan
stories.description: A new AMTI report says Beijing deployed law enforcement ships and hailed nearly 200 commercial vessels in the Philippine Sea since June.

stories.title: FBI raids Swalwell's home, seizes devices in misconduct probe
stories.description: Agents executed search warrants at San Francisco's airport and his D.C. residence over the weekend as part of a federal sexual assault investigation.

stories.title: Bessent says Treasury buybacks could top $4B per operation
stories.description: The Treasury secretary signaled further expansion of bond repurchases a day after doubling the program, citing "very poor" liquidity in long-term debt.

stories.title: Houthis claim drone strikes on Saudi airport, Aramco site
stories.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards warned hours earlier that Saudi Arabia would be "unable to contain" the Houthi rebels' escalating campaign.

stories.title: Qatar, Oman lead push to reopen Strait of Hormuz as Iran confirms zero oil exports
stories.description: Iran's central bank governor acknowledged the country is exporting no oil, as Gulf states launched a diplomatic initiative to restore shipping.

stories.title: Russian strikes kill 16 in Kyiv as global missile shortage deepens
stories.description: Zelenskyy blamed allies' failure to replenish air defense stocks after a massive overnight attack hit residential areas, a children's hospital and a school.

stories.title: Romania destroys explosive sea drone near major Black Sea gas platform
stories.description: EU chief von der Leyen called the incident "hybrid warfare" as Romania's president blamed Russia for escalating threats to critical energy infrastructure.

stories.title: North Korea fires 10+ missiles hours after Trump vows to meet Kim Jong Un
stories.description: Pyongyang's largest single-day volley this year came as curtailed US-South Korea military exercises near their end.

stories.title: Evergrande founder sentenced to life in prison by Chinese court
stories.description: Hui Ka Yan was convicted on eight charges including fraud and embezzlement after the property giant's $300 billion default shook China's economy.

stories.title: Army phases out drone battalion in Hegseth-backed shift
stories.description: The cutting-edge unit, established in Europe in January to master drone warfare lessons from Ukraine, will revert to conventional airborne infantry.

stories.title: US envoy warns Israel-Turkey nearly reached direct military confrontation over Syria strike
stories.description: Tom Barrack said Turkish forces were unaware of incoming Israeli jets and could have scrambled fighters, risking a dangerous escalation.

stories.title: Harry and Meghan moving back to Britain after 6 years
stories.description: The couple's children are enrolled in a British school starting in September, with the family relocating to a private home outside London.

stories.title: Ousted defense chief Fedorov calls for wartime elections in biggest challenge to Zelenskyy
stories.description: Once a close Zelenskyy ally, Mykhailo Fedorov cited a "systemic crisis of governance" and condemned corruption in a nine-minute YouTube address.

stories.title: Trump tours White House helipad, ballroom sites as Supreme Court weighs halt
stories.description: The president briefed reporters Wednesday amid a legal fight over the $400 million ballroom, which an appeals court ordered stopped on Aug. 7.

stories.title: Germany condemns Ben-Gvir, drops opposition to EU sanctions
stories.description: Berlin had previously blocked EU sanctions against the Israeli minister but now backs action after his call for nightly killings in Gaza.

stories.title: Merck, Moderna mRNA cancer vaccine succeeds in Phase 3 trial
stories.description: Intismeran, a personalized mRNA therapy, reduced melanoma recurrence when added to Keytruda, marking the first positive Phase 3 result for a neoantigen cancer treatment.

stories.title: EU leaders back ICC after US sanctions its president
stories.description: Half of the ICC's judges are now under U.S. sanctions as the Trump administration escalates its campaign against the Hague-based court.

stories.title: Unitree Robotics surges 460% in Shanghai debut
stories.description: China's first publicly traded humanoid robot maker closed its first day of trading at 845 yuan, up from an IPO price of 150.8 yuan.

stories.title: Ex-Fauci adviser pleads guilty to concealing COVID-19 records
stories.description: David Morens admitted to conspiring to evade public records laws tied to pandemic research grants, including efforts to revive a controversial bat coronavirus grant.

stories.title: Florida primaries oust Rep. Mills, advance Trump-backed newcomers
stories.description: Redrawn congressional maps reshaped Tuesday's races, with an ethics-plagued incumbent falling and first-time candidates winning key GOP nominations.

stories.title: Hegseth accused of hiding Iran's destruction of key US base in Bahrain
stories.description: The allegation helps explain why the USS Abraham Lincoln's 5,000 sailors have faced food shortages and deteriorating conditions during a record 250-day deployment.

stories.title: Trump taps White House aide Overton to lead FDA
stories.description: The pick follows months of turmoil at the agency after its previous commissioner departed amid clashes with staff and industry.

stories.title: Angie Nixon upsets Vindman in Florida Senate primary
stories.description: The Democratic socialist and Jacksonville state lawmaker defeated the heavily favored impeachment witness despite being outspent roughly 16 to 1.

stories.title: US sanctions ICC president in latest bid to dismantle court
stories.description: Secretary of State Rubio called the ICC "corrupt and fatally politicized" as Washington targeted the court's top judge and a senior trial lawyer.

stories.title: Judge lifts last block on Trump ending TPS protections
stories.description: Ethiopia was the final country shielded by a court order. The ruling follows the Supreme Court's June decision curbing judicial review of TPS terminations.

stories.title: Wasserman Schultz wins Florida primary in historically Black district
stories.description: The former DNC chair defeated four Black candidates after a divided field failed to consolidate, drawing sharp criticism over race and representation.

stories.title: Israel orders troops to halt Gaza advance after Kushner meeting
stories.description: The directive marks the first time Israeli forces were told to stop expanding westward since the ceasefire began last October.

stories.title: Minnesota sues Texas to force extradition of ICE agent charged in shooting
stories.description: AG Keith Ellison filed a federal lawsuit against Gov. Abbott, warning the agent could walk free from a border jail by Aug. 26.

stories.title: Disney sues FCC over 'retaliatory' ABC license challenge
stories.description: The lawsuit, filed Tuesday in D.C. federal court, alleges the agency is suppressing speech critical of the Trump administration.

stories.title: Tupac Shakur murder trial opens with testimony in Las Vegas
stories.description: Prosecutors say Duane "Keffe D" Davis planned the 1996 drive-by shooting in retaliation for a beating of his nephew earlier that evening.

stories.title: DOJ to deploy 1,000 election monitors for midterms
stories.description: Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon announced the dramatic expansion Monday, also signaling the voter roll legal battle could reach the Supreme Court.

stories.title: Trump scales back Korea military drills over stalled $350B investment pledge
stories.description: Commerce Secretary Lutnick met Monday with Seoul's trade minister as the U.S. pressures South Korea to deliver on commitments made over a year ago.

stories.title: Mangione state murder trial postponed after federal plea
stories.description: His lawyers argue New York's double jeopardy law bars the state from prosecuting him for the same conduct he admitted to in federal court.

stories.title: Big Tech carries $3T in hidden AI spending commitments, WSJ finds
stories.description: Nine major tech firms have nearly five times more AI-related financial obligations than their reported capital expenditures suggest, according to a new analysis.

stories.title: Trump approval rating sinks to 33%, lowest of presidency
stories.description: A Reuters/Ipsos poll finds 80% of Americans expect the Iran conflict to drag on as rising gas prices and inflation fuel broad discontent.

stories.title: AG Blanche finalizes rule letting non-violent felons seek gun rights restoration
stories.description: The DOJ expects about 330,000 applications in the first year. Violent felons and sex offenders remain presumptively ineligible.

stories.title: Nvidia finalizes $105B guarantee for massive OpenAI data center in Ohio
stories.description: The chipmaker will also invest $1.5 billion in SB Energy for the PORTS-Pike campus, scaled back from a previously discussed $250 billion backstop.

stories.title: Supreme Court again rejects Trump appeal in Carroll case
stories.description: The justices declined for a second time to hear Trump's challenge to a $5 million sexual abuse and defamation verdict won by E. Jean Carroll.

stories.title: Russia built 10 secret drone bases within range of NATO
stories.description: A Telegraph investigation found 59 new launch rails for advanced jet-powered drones along Russia's borders with Ukraine and Belarus.

stories.title: Kushner meets Netanyahu to push Gaza plan after rare Hamas talks
stories.description: Trump's son-in-law sat down with Israel's prime minister Monday after a two-hour meeting with Hamas' leader in Egypt a day earlier.

stories.title: Iran secretly prepared for wider war during US peace talks, Journal reports
stories.description: Tehran used the June ceasefire period to reorganize its military, expand militia coordination, and plan offensive operations, according to Iranian and Arab officials.

stories.title: AG Blanche declines to pledge DOJ independence from White House
stories.description: Blanche told "Meet the Press" he would consider Trump's views on decisions, saying "no attorney general should ever pledge" independence.

stories.title: Qatar denies Iran's claim it is holding three captured pilots
stories.description: Tehran says three Su-24 pilots have been held incommunicado since March. Doha calls the allegations misleading and says no surviving aircrew are in custody.

stories.title: U.S. warns allies to pick sides in AI race with China
stories.description: A leaked State Department draft letter tells 35 nations they cannot belong to both Washington's Pax Silica coalition and Beijing's rival AI framework.

stories.title: DOJ says troops can arrest migrants beyond border military zones
stories.description: The Office of Legal Counsel opinion expands arrest powers to areas just outside designated National Defense Areas along the southern border.

stories.title: Jason Arday, ex-Cambridge professor in plagiarism row, found dead at 41
stories.description: Arday was found unresponsive at his London home Friday. Police said his death is unexpected but not believed to be suspicious.

stories.title: Britain's wildfires hit record levels as Europe's fifth heatwave rages
stories.description: Fire chiefs say wildfire numbers have surpassed 2025's record, with demand outstripping rescue capacity during Europe's deadliest summer heat in decades.

stories.title: White House email urged agencies to take action against Colorado, court records show
stories.description: A December 2025 email called on five federal agencies to "discuss immediate actions" regarding Colorado; grants were canceled within days.

stories.title: Man found alive under collapsed hotel four days after Colombia quake
stories.description: Rescuers race to free a trapped survivor as the death toll holds at 281 and the critical 72-hour window for finding others has passed.

stories.title: NATO jets shoot down drone over Latvia amid massive Ukrainian assault on Russia
stories.description: Latvia said the drone entered its airspace due to Russian electronic warfare during an overnight Ukrainian attack that also struck Russia's largest Baltic Sea port.

stories.title: Trump shifts Cuba strategy to sanctions over military action
stories.description: The administration is focused on cutting off revenue to Cuba's regime rather than pursuing a military operation like the January raid on Venezuela.

stories.title: Released Fauci texts fuel debunked vaccine-miscarriage claims
stories.description: Conservative lawmakers and influencers seized on newly released 2021 text messages to revive false claims that COVID-19 vaccines caused miscarriages, despite extensive research showing no such link.

stories.title: Bessent vows unprecedented economic isolation of Iran
stories.description: The Treasury secretary said new measures will be announced next week alongside a continued blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: DHS confirms undisclosed third death tied to Delaney Hall detention center
stories.description: ICE cited a Trump-era policy change to explain why Jose Chajon-Raxon's July death was not disclosed until now.

stories.title: Iran demands environmental terms for Strait of Hormuz amid twin Gulf oil spills
stories.description: Two spills are fouling Gulf waters: one off Iran's Qeshm Island and a massive leak from a grounded Russian shadow fleet tanker off Oman.

stories.title: Trump orders Navy to ditch electromagnetic catapults on carriers, costing billions
stories.description: The national security memorandum directs the Navy to revert to steam-powered catapults on future Ford-class carriers, a shift expected to cost billions.

stories.title: NYC pied-à-terre tax back in effect after appeals court lifts restraining order
stories.description: An appellate judge temporarily reversed a lower court's Monday pause, allowing the city to resume its luxury second-home tax rollout.

stories.title: Ukraine grain exports plunge 75% as Russian strikes shut Black Sea ports
stories.description: No foreign cargo vessel has entered or left Odesa's ports since July 22, trapping Ukraine's wheat harvest at its peak.

stories.title: Trump authorizes private firms to hack foreign cybercriminals
stories.description: A new presidential memorandum lets vetted U.S. companies conduct offensive cyber operations against transnational criminal organizations under federal oversight.

stories.title: Flock Safety mandates new safeguards after police stalking cases
stories.description: CEO Garrett Langley says "we got this one wrong" as the company makes abuse-detection tools mandatory for all law enforcement clients.

stories.title: Ukraine drone strike forces Russian refinery into six-month shutdown
stories.description: Sanctions block access to imported equipment needed to repair the Orsk plant, the fourth Russian refinery shut down since early August.

stories.title: Kennedy Center board votes to add Trump's name back despite judge's order
stories.description: The 20-3 vote also approved closing the main building for a $250 million, two-year renovation, with a plan due to the court next week.

stories.title: Huckabee calls West Bank settler siege 'act of terror'
stories.description: The US ambassador to Israel, a longtime supporter of settlements, sharply condemned a days-long siege of Palestinian homes in the village of Qusra.

stories.title: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan to form military bodies under new defense pact
stories.description: Turkey's defense ministry said Thursday the three nations will coordinate through defense ministers, foreign ministers and military chiefs under the Mecca agreement.

stories.title: Judge dismisses Trump antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard
stories.description: The government's claims of ongoing civil rights violations were "too isolated and episodic," the federal judge ruled Thursday.

stories.title: Russia strikes Ukraine's Izmail port, igniting fire at key grain hub
stories.description: The overnight drone attack came a day after Ukraine hit Russia's Novorossiysk port, escalating tit-for-tat strikes on Black Sea grain infrastructure.

stories.title: White House to extend AI safety framework to open-source models
stories.description: The policy shift reverses the administration's position from early August, when it explicitly exempted open-weight models from voluntary pre-release testing.

stories.title: Karoline Leavitt stepping down as White House press secretary
stories.description: Trump said Leavitt, 28, the youngest person ever in the role, will leave by month's end to focus on her family.

stories.title: Tehran mayor reveals Khamenei's wife killed in US-Israeli strike
stories.description: Alireza Zakani disclosed new details about the February 28 attack, as Iran's IRGC said the supreme leader's ongoing absence is purely a security measure.

stories.title: Millions gather across Spain for first total solar eclipse in over a century
stories.description: The moon's shadow swept from Greenland and Iceland to the Iberian Peninsula on Wednesday, drawing an estimated 6 million viewers.

stories.title: FAA to relocate antennas after Marine One near-miss over D.C.
stories.description: Radio failures let an American Airlines jet depart while Marine One was nearby, and the FAA is now preparing antenna and protocol changes at Reagan National.

stories.title: CIA warns Europe of Russian hybrid attack plans targeting Baltics, Poland
stories.description: Bloomberg reports U.S. intelligence has alerted allies that Moscow is weighing infrastructure sabotage and false-flag operations against NATO's eastern flank.

stories.title: Oil from grounded Russian tanker reaches Oman's mainland as spill spreads
stories.description: The IMO confirmed crude from the Caroline Bezengi is now hitting beaches over 200 km from the wreck site, with monsoon winds hampering containment.

stories.title: SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.6, claiming parity with GPT-5.6 Sol and Fable 5
stories.description: The new model is priced at roughly half the cost of comparable frontier AI rivals and is available immediately through Cursor, Grok Build, and the API.

stories.title: Crowley upsets Hong in tight Wisconsin Democratic gov primary
stories.description: The Milwaukee County executive completed a dramatic comeback to narrowly defeat democratic socialist Francesca Hong and will face Trump-backed Rep. Tom Tiffany in November.

stories.title: US core inflation hits slowest pace since 2021, easing Fed rate hike pressure
stories.description: The core CPI rose 2.5% annually in July, matching the slowest rate since March 2021, as the Fed remains divided over whether to raise rates.

stories.title: Ukraine halts Black Sea tanker strikes at Vance's request
stories.description: Kyiv agreed to stop targeting oil tankers at Russia's Novorossiysk port after VP Vance asked Zelenskyy in a July 31 call, the Financial Times reported.

stories.title: Putin threatens to seize European ships over shadow fleet crackdown
stories.description: Speaking from a warship off Sakhalin, Putin called EU maritime enforcement "piracy" and vowed retaliation "wherever we deem it necessary."

stories.title: ICE plans to spend up to $20M on electric shock gloves for officers
stories.description: A DHS procurement notice reveals the agency seeks thousands of gloves that deliver painful shocks, drawing sharp criticism from the ACLU.

stories.title: Demuth defeats Trump-backed Lindell in Minnesota GOP primary
stories.description: Minnesota House Speaker Lisa Demuth will face Sen. Amy Klobuchar in November after winning a three-way Republican gubernatorial primary Tuesday.

stories.title: US cyclosporiasis cases near 14,000 as outbreak spreads
stories.description: CDC confirmed cases have risen to 13,895 since May 1, with Sysco halting all Mexican iceberg lettuce purchases amid the largest outbreak on record.

stories.title: Trump ends Medicaid funding for youth trans care
stories.description: The rule, set to take effect Oct. 13, bars federal coverage of puberty blockers, hormones, and surgeries for minors in 17 states.

stories.title: Russia frees ex-Marine Robert Gilman after Putin pardon
stories.description: The 32-year-old Massachusetts man was near death in a psychiatric ward after four years of detention on disputed charges.

stories.title: Zelensky says Ukraine hit Siberian target 2,500 km away
stories.description: The strike on a Tobolsk petrochemical complex marks a major expansion of Kyiv's deep-strike range, with Zelensky vowing more attacks.

stories.title: Trump White House halted GOP push to oust Rep. Miller from Ohio race
stories.description: The embattled congressman, facing domestic and child abuse allegations, passed the deadline to be replaced on the November ballot.

stories.title: Syrian court sentences Assad to death in absentia
stories.description: The Damascus ruling marks the first conviction of the former president since his overthrow in December 2024.

stories.title: July was the hottest month ever recorded in the US, NOAA says
stories.description: Temperatures averaged 76.9°F across the lower 48 states, eclipsing a Dust Bowl-era record that had stood since 1936.

stories.title: Trump doesn't rule out national emergency to control midterm elections
stories.description: In a Tuesday interview, the president told a far-right host "stranger things have happened" when pitched on declaring an election emergency.

stories.title: Meta confirms its AI model hacked a company during security testing
stories.description: A misconfiguration gave the model internet access, and it exploited a real company's vulnerability — the third such incident tied to startup Irregular.

stories.title: Nearly 100 large wildfires burn across western US as thousands evacuate
stories.description: Over 30,000 firefighters are battling blazes across 10 states, with more than 5.6 million acres burned nationwide so far in 2026.

stories.title: White House pushes DOJ to refile charges in Reflecting Pool case
stories.description: House Democrats simultaneously launched a probe into why the flawed felony case against ex-Olympian David Hearn was brought in the first place.

stories.title: Ukrainian drone strike kills at least 13 in Russia's Tatarstan energy hub
stories.description: The overnight attack on Nizhnekamsk, home to major oil refineries, is among the deadliest single strikes on Russian soil since the full-scale war began.

stories.title: Iran elevates veteran IRGC commander to top security post
stories.description: Mohsen Rezaei, who led the Revolutionary Guard Corps for 16 years, takes over Iran's security council amid the Strait of Hormuz standoff.

stories.title: CBO projects $2.1T deficit after tariff revenue collapse
stories.description: Lost tariff revenue from the Supreme Court's ruling striking down Trump's tariff program drove a $200 billion increase in the fiscal 2026 deficit forecast.

stories.title: British Columbia declares emergency as wildfire forces 20,000 to flee Okanagan
stories.description: The Bald Range fire has burned over 10,000 hectares and remains out of control, destroying homes and trapping residents near Summerland.

stories.title: El-Sayed defends Medicare for All after Michigan primary win
stories.description: The Democratic Senate nominee acknowledged the plan could raise taxes but told NBC's "Meet the Press" the U.S. can "ensure healthcare from birth to death."

stories.title: Trump Media signs up 10-plus firms for early Truth Social access
stories.description: The service charges trading firms up to $100,000 a month for milliseconds-faster delivery of posts from the president's account.

stories.title: Hunter Biden says father's cancer has spread further
stories.description: In an emotional BBC interview, Hunter Biden said Joe Biden's prostate cancer has metastasized further and is "very painful" and "very debilitating."

stories.title: UAE condemns Iranian missile strike on ADNOC tanker in Strait of Hormuz
stories.description: The foreign ministry called the attack "an act of piracy" by the IRGC and demanded Iran unconditionally reopen the critical waterway.

stories.title: Trump demands Iran pay compensation as Hormuz standoff intensifies
stories.description: The president turned Tehran's war reparations demand back on Iran, saying he is "likewise demanding compensation" for American and allied casualties.

stories.title: DHS proposes ending 60-day grace period for laid-off H-1B workers
stories.description: The rule, sent to the White House for review Thursday, would strip foreign workers of time to find new sponsors after a job loss.

stories.title: Explosive drone detonates in Bulgaria near major gas pipeline
stories.description: The unidentified drone exploded in a sunflower field near the Trans-Balkan gas pipeline, with no casualties reported.

stories.title: Pentagon extends DC National Guard mission through 2029 at $1.4B cost
stories.description: As the deployment nears its one-year anniversary, nearly 9,700 troops have rotated through Washington under Trump's "Make DC Safe and Beautiful" initiative.

stories.title: U.S. intel links Russia to explosive drone at German airport
stories.description: A bus driver kicked the armed drone away near Ukrainian cargo planes at Leipzig/Halle Airport, a key NATO logistics hub.

stories.title: White House renews push to fire Fed Governor Cook
stories.description: The administration gave Cook until late August to respond to mortgage fraud allegations her attorney calls "baseless."

stories.title: Senate passes spending bill, sidesteps Trump's voting and war demands
stories.description: Senators voted 90-6 to fund the government through Dec. 11, then confirmed Todd Blanche as attorney general before adjourning for a five-week recess.

stories.title: Army removes top U.S. general in Europe from command
stories.description: Lt. Gen. Charles Costanza was relieved as V Corps commander over conduct issues, sources say, weeks before his planned October transition.

stories.title: Senate passes Russia, Iran sanctions bill named for late Lindsey Graham
stories.description: The bipartisan 86-11 vote sends the long-stalled measure to the House, where it faces resistance over tariff provisions.

stories.title: Senate confirms DOJ inspector general in 74-nominee package
stories.description: Donald Berthiaume, who has served as acting watchdog since October 2025, was confirmed in a 51-47 party-line vote alongside dozens of other Trump picks.

stories.title: OpenAI slows Astra model over critical cyber risks
stories.description: The company says it "cannot rule out" that the unreleased model can autonomously exploit hardened systems, triggering its strictest safety protocols.

stories.title: US lost 23,000 jobs in July, defying forecasts
stories.description: The unemployment rate fell to 4.1% even as payrolls declined, sending conflicting signals about the labor market's health.

stories.title: Puerto Rico begins 48-hour water rationing as record drought grips island
stories.description: Over 180,000 customers in San Juan and six other municipalities face rotating shutoffs with no end date set amid the worst drought in over a decade.

stories.title: Danube drought forces Hungary, Romania to dim cities and cut power
stories.description: Nuclear plants hobbled by record-low river levels have triggered the region's worst energy crisis in decades, with factories halting production.

stories.title: Trump grows frustrated with DHS Secretary Mullin
stories.description: The president is exasperated by off-message comments from his second homeland security chief, who was told to keep the agency out of the spotlight.

stories.title: US intel warns Putin may test NATO with limited attack
stories.description: Lithuania disclosed intelligence on a potential Russian false-flag drone operation in the Baltics the same day the assessment surfaced.

stories.title: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay $567M over youth mental health harms
stories.description: The ruling adds to a $375 million jury verdict from March, bringing Meta's total liability in the state to nearly $1 billion.

stories.title: Top US general privately pushes for off-ramp from Iran war
stories.description: Gen. Dan Caine has lobbied key Cabinet officials, warning that escalation options could backfire and airpower alone won't achieve Trump's objectives.

stories.title: Spokane fire suspect admits to setting 25 blazes over past year
stories.description: Aaron Farinacci, 37, now faces five counts of first-degree arson, with prosecutors warning more charges may follow as the investigation continues.

stories.title: Sen. McConnell discharged from rehab after 50-day stay
stories.description: The 84-year-old Kentucky Republican will continue physical therapy at home but gave no timeline for returning to the Senate.

stories.title: Trump's Board of Peace awards first Gaza construction contract
stories.description: The military outpost for 150 Moroccan troops would be built in Israeli-controlled territory as part of a planned international stabilization force.

stories.title: Warren demands answers on planned changes to inflation data
stories.description: The senator's letter to the Commerce Department questions whether upcoming PCE revisions could mask persistent price pressures on households.

stories.title: AI power swings are breaking data center equipment, report finds
stories.description: A Bloomberg investigation found rapid GPU power fluctuations are cracking turbines, destroying batteries, and threatening grid stability worldwide.

stories.title: Trump orders leak probe over munitions shortage reports
stories.description: The president denied weapons shortfalls amid the Iran war and vowed to jail those who disclosed military inventory data he called "treasonous."

stories.title: Kim Yo Jong warns of military response to Japan's first Tomahawk test
stories.description: North Korea vowed "additional military options" against Japan after Tokyo test-fired a U.S.-made Tomahawk cruise missile for the first time.

stories.title: Hassabis steps down as DeepMind CEO to focus on AGI
stories.description: Koray Kavukcuoglu takes over as head of Google DeepMind while Jeff Dean departs after 27 years at the company.

stories.title: Trump signs new orders limiting birthright citizenship after Supreme Court loss
stories.description: The executive orders target birth tourism and children of foreign diplomats, narrowing the scope of his earlier attempt struck down in June.

stories.title: Hegseth denies report that Iran war drained 80% of US missile stockpile
stories.description: CNN reported that THAAD and Patriot interceptor reserves have hit "dangerously low" levels, but the Pentagon calls the claim false.

stories.title: Johnson calls Miller abuse allegations 'serious' but defers to Ethics Committee
stories.description: The speaker distanced himself from the Ohio Republican's claim of support, saying "it's not my business" to intervene in members' personal matters.

stories.title: Trump administration proposes sweeping Head Start overhaul
stories.description: The proposed rule would eliminate most federal standards for the early childhood program serving 700,000 low-income children, shifting oversight to states.

top.title: US, Japan, South Korea hold urgent talks after North Korean missile barrage
top.description: Senior diplomats coordinated their response Friday after Pyongyang fired about 10 ballistic missiles, dismissing Trump's scaled-back military drills.

top.title: Iran's Pezeshkian calls for end to US war from 'position of strength'
top.description: The Iranian president defended a June deal with Washington as the US pivoted to what it called the "toughest sanctions in history."

top.title: US, Canada race to finalize trade deal before Saturday tariff deadline
top.description: Negotiators are working through Friday in Washington as 50% tariffs on $20 billion in Canadian goods are set to take effect at 12:01 a.m. ET Saturday.

top.title: White House furor over Natalie Harp intensifies after week of damaging leaks
top.description: A pointed remark by Sen. Jon Ossoff about Trump's ever-present aide spiraled into a national story after the West Wing's aggressive pushback backfired.

top.title: Vance says US moving up to 15M barrels daily through Hormuz despite Iran blockade
top.description: The vice president said a military-protected shipping corridor is preventing the energy crisis Iran is trying to create.

top.title: Ukraine asks Musk to allow Starlink strikes deep into Russia
top.description: Kyiv wants to use Starlink-equipped drones to hit Russian missile launchers up to 200 km inside Russia amid a critical Patriot shortage.

top.title: Trump admin moves to strip ABA of law school accreditation power
top.description: The Education Department is beginning formal proceedings to revoke the ABA's authority as the sole accreditor of the nation's law schools.

top.title: New York Times ordered to pay $9.25M in landmark defamation verdict
top.description: An Alabama jury found the Times defamed former walk-on player Kai Spears, marking the paper's first U.S. defamation trial loss in over 50 years.

top.title: Hong Kong convicts Tiananmen vigil leaders of subversion
top.description: Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung were found guilty of inciting subversion for advocating an end to one-party rule in China. They face up to 10 years in prison.

top.title: Trump withholds mandated 2024 election interference report
top.description: The administration has released hundreds of pages of other declassified material while keeping the congressionally required foreign interference assessment secret.

top.title: Somali pirates seize 2 ships in 4 days as hijackings hit decade high
top.description: Six ships and over 100 crew members are now held captive as naval forces stretched by Middle East conflicts leave Somali waters less patrolled.

top.title: USS Abraham Lincoln heads home after record 272 days at sea
top.description: The George Washington arrived Wednesday to relieve the Lincoln, whose crew endured supply shortages and mental health crises during the Iran war.

top.title: Trump joins Michael Cohen's radio show in public reunion
top.description: Cohen, the star witness in Trump's 2024 hush money trial, hosted the president on his WABC program after months of quiet reconciliation.

top.title: Wahab wins California special election despite AIPAC spending
top.description: State Sen. Aisha Wahab defeated Melissa Hernandez to fill Rep. Eric Swalwell's vacated House seat, overcoming millions in outside spending.

top.title: First U.S. deportation flight lands in Liberia under new deal
top.description: Twenty migrants arrived Thursday as part of a pact allowing up to 1,200 third-country deportees to be sent to the West African nation.

top.title: Navy weighs renaming carrier honoring Black WWII hero after Trump
top.description: The Ford-class carrier CVN-81, designated USS Doris Miller during Trump's first term, may become the first carrier named for a sitting president.

top.title: Seven nations urge Israel to withdraw E1 settlement tenders
top.description: The UK summoned Israel's chargé d'affaires and joined six other Western governments in calling the West Bank construction plan "unacceptable."

top.title: Anthropic aims to match or top SpaceX's record IPO
top.description: The Claude developer filed a confidential S-1 with the SEC and could go public as soon as late August, according to Bloomberg.

top.title: DHS could identify only 185 of 16,000 alleged noncitizen voters in Nevada
top.description: The Trump administration's sweeping claims of illegal voter registration are unraveling as federal agencies fail to substantiate the president's assertions ahead of the midterms.

top.title: FBI arrests woman in ISIS-inspired plot to bomb N.Y. Capitol
top.description: Jessica Bowie, 35, of Albany was charged with planning to deploy an explosive at the state Capitol to kill lawmakers, the DOJ said.

top.title: China builds 'unprecedented' maritime presence east of Taiwan
top.description: A new AMTI report says Beijing deployed law enforcement ships and hailed nearly 200 commercial vessels in the Philippine Sea since June.

top.title: FBI raids Swalwell's home, seizes devices in misconduct probe
top.description: Agents executed search warrants at San Francisco's airport and his D.C. residence over the weekend as part of a federal sexual assault investigation.

top.title: Bessent says Treasury buybacks could top $4B per operation
top.description: The Treasury secretary signaled further expansion of bond repurchases a day after doubling the program, citing "very poor" liquidity in long-term debt.

top.title: Houthis claim drone strikes on Saudi airport, Aramco site
top.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards warned hours earlier that Saudi Arabia would be "unable to contain" the Houthi rebels' escalating campaign.

top.title: Qatar, Oman lead push to reopen Strait of Hormuz as Iran confirms zero oil exports
top.description: Iran's central bank governor acknowledged the country is exporting no oil, as Gulf states launched a diplomatic initiative to restore shipping.

top.title: Russian strikes kill 16 in Kyiv as global missile shortage deepens
top.description: Zelenskyy blamed allies' failure to replenish air defense stocks after a massive overnight attack hit residential areas, a children's hospital and a school.

top.title: Romania destroys explosive sea drone near major Black Sea gas platform
top.description: EU chief von der Leyen called the incident "hybrid warfare" as Romania's president blamed Russia for escalating threats to critical energy infrastructure.

top.title: North Korea fires 10+ missiles hours after Trump vows to meet Kim Jong Un
top.description: Pyongyang's largest single-day volley this year came as curtailed US-South Korea military exercises near their end.

top.title: Evergrande founder sentenced to life in prison by Chinese court
top.description: Hui Ka Yan was convicted on eight charges including fraud and embezzlement after the property giant's $300 billion default shook China's economy.

top.title: Army phases out drone battalion in Hegseth-backed shift
top.description: The cutting-edge unit, established in Europe in January to master drone warfare lessons from Ukraine, will revert to conventional airborne infantry.

top.title: US envoy warns Israel-Turkey nearly reached direct military confrontation over Syria strike
top.description: Tom Barrack said Turkish forces were unaware of incoming Israeli jets and could have scrambled fighters, risking a dangerous escalation.

top.title: Harry and Meghan moving back to Britain after 6 years
top.description: The couple's children are enrolled in a British school starting in September, with the family relocating to a private home outside London.

top.title: Ousted defense chief Fedorov calls for wartime elections in biggest challenge to Zelenskyy
top.description: Once a close Zelenskyy ally, Mykhailo Fedorov cited a "systemic crisis of governance" and condemned corruption in a nine-minute YouTube address.

top.title: Trump tours White House helipad, ballroom sites as Supreme Court weighs halt
top.description: The president briefed reporters Wednesday amid a legal fight over the $400 million ballroom, which an appeals court ordered stopped on Aug. 7.

top.title: Germany condemns Ben-Gvir, drops opposition to EU sanctions
top.description: Berlin had previously blocked EU sanctions against the Israeli minister but now backs action after his call for nightly killings in Gaza.

top.title: Merck, Moderna mRNA cancer vaccine succeeds in Phase 3 trial
top.description: Intismeran, a personalized mRNA therapy, reduced melanoma recurrence when added to Keytruda, marking the first positive Phase 3 result for a neoantigen cancer treatment.

top.title: EU leaders back ICC after US sanctions its president
top.description: Half of the ICC's judges are now under U.S. sanctions as the Trump administration escalates its campaign against the Hague-based court.

top.title: Unitree Robotics surges 460% in Shanghai debut
top.description: China's first publicly traded humanoid robot maker closed its first day of trading at 845 yuan, up from an IPO price of 150.8 yuan.

top.title: Ex-Fauci adviser pleads guilty to concealing COVID-19 records
top.description: David Morens admitted to conspiring to evade public records laws tied to pandemic research grants, including efforts to revive a controversial bat coronavirus grant.

top.title: Florida primaries oust Rep. Mills, advance Trump-backed newcomers
top.description: Redrawn congressional maps reshaped Tuesday's races, with an ethics-plagued incumbent falling and first-time candidates winning key GOP nominations.

top.title: Hegseth accused of hiding Iran's destruction of key US base in Bahrain
top.description: The allegation helps explain why the USS Abraham Lincoln's 5,000 sailors have faced food shortages and deteriorating conditions during a record 250-day deployment.

top.title: Trump taps White House aide Overton to lead FDA
top.description: The pick follows months of turmoil at the agency after its previous commissioner departed amid clashes with staff and industry.

top.title: Angie Nixon upsets Vindman in Florida Senate primary
top.description: The Democratic socialist and Jacksonville state lawmaker defeated the heavily favored impeachment witness despite being outspent roughly 16 to 1.

top.title: US sanctions ICC president in latest bid to dismantle court
top.description: Secretary of State Rubio called the ICC "corrupt and fatally politicized" as Washington targeted the court's top judge and a senior trial lawyer.

top.title: Judge lifts last block on Trump ending TPS protections
top.description: Ethiopia was the final country shielded by a court order. The ruling follows the Supreme Court's June decision curbing judicial review of TPS terminations.

top.title: Wasserman Schultz wins Florida primary in historically Black district
top.description: The former DNC chair defeated four Black candidates after a divided field failed to consolidate, drawing sharp criticism over race and representation.

top.title: Israel orders troops to halt Gaza advance after Kushner meeting
top.description: The directive marks the first time Israeli forces were told to stop expanding westward since the ceasefire began last October.

top.title: Minnesota sues Texas to force extradition of ICE agent charged in shooting
top.description: AG Keith Ellison filed a federal lawsuit against Gov. Abbott, warning the agent could walk free from a border jail by Aug. 26.

top.title: Disney sues FCC over 'retaliatory' ABC license challenge
top.description: The lawsuit, filed Tuesday in D.C. federal court, alleges the agency is suppressing speech critical of the Trump administration.

top.title: Tupac Shakur murder trial opens with testimony in Las Vegas
top.description: Prosecutors say Duane "Keffe D" Davis planned the 1996 drive-by shooting in retaliation for a beating of his nephew earlier that evening.

top.title: DOJ to deploy 1,000 election monitors for midterms
top.description: Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon announced the dramatic expansion Monday, also signaling the voter roll legal battle could reach the Supreme Court.

top.title: Trump scales back Korea military drills over stalled $350B investment pledge
top.description: Commerce Secretary Lutnick met Monday with Seoul's trade minister as the U.S. pressures South Korea to deliver on commitments made over a year ago.

top.title: Mangione state murder trial postponed after federal plea
top.description: His lawyers argue New York's double jeopardy law bars the state from prosecuting him for the same conduct he admitted to in federal court.

top.title: Big Tech carries $3T in hidden AI spending commitments, WSJ finds
top.description: Nine major tech firms have nearly five times more AI-related financial obligations than their reported capital expenditures suggest, according to a new analysis.

top.title: Trump approval rating sinks to 33%, lowest of presidency
top.description: A Reuters/Ipsos poll finds 80% of Americans expect the Iran conflict to drag on as rising gas prices and inflation fuel broad discontent.

top.title: AG Blanche finalizes rule letting non-violent felons seek gun rights restoration
top.description: The DOJ expects about 330,000 applications in the first year. Violent felons and sex offenders remain presumptively ineligible.

top.title: Nvidia finalizes $105B guarantee for massive OpenAI data center in Ohio
top.description: The chipmaker will also invest $1.5 billion in SB Energy for the PORTS-Pike campus, scaled back from a previously discussed $250 billion backstop.

top.title: Supreme Court again rejects Trump appeal in Carroll case
top.description: The justices declined for a second time to hear Trump's challenge to a $5 million sexual abuse and defamation verdict won by E. Jean Carroll.

top.title: Russia built 10 secret drone bases within range of NATO
top.description: A Telegraph investigation found 59 new launch rails for advanced jet-powered drones along Russia's borders with Ukraine and Belarus.

top.title: Kushner meets Netanyahu to push Gaza plan after rare Hamas talks
top.description: Trump's son-in-law sat down with Israel's prime minister Monday after a two-hour meeting with Hamas' leader in Egypt a day earlier.

top.title: Iran secretly prepared for wider war during US peace talks, Journal reports
top.description: Tehran used the June ceasefire period to reorganize its military, expand militia coordination, and plan offensive operations, according to Iranian and Arab officials.

top.title: AG Blanche declines to pledge DOJ independence from White House
top.description: Blanche told "Meet the Press" he would consider Trump's views on decisions, saying "no attorney general should ever pledge" independence.

top.title: Qatar denies Iran's claim it is holding three captured pilots
top.description: Tehran says three Su-24 pilots have been held incommunicado since March. Doha calls the allegations misleading and says no surviving aircrew are in custody.

top.title: U.S. warns allies to pick sides in AI race with China
top.description: A leaked State Department draft letter tells 35 nations they cannot belong to both Washington's Pax Silica coalition and Beijing's rival AI framework.

top.title: DOJ says troops can arrest migrants beyond border military zones
top.description: The Office of Legal Counsel opinion expands arrest powers to areas just outside designated National Defense Areas along the southern border.

top.title: Jason Arday, ex-Cambridge professor in plagiarism row, found dead at 41
top.description: Arday was found unresponsive at his London home Friday. Police said his death is unexpected but not believed to be suspicious.

top.title: Britain's wildfires hit record levels as Europe's fifth heatwave rages
top.description: Fire chiefs say wildfire numbers have surpassed 2025's record, with demand outstripping rescue capacity during Europe's deadliest summer heat in decades.

top.title: White House email urged agencies to take action against Colorado, court records show
top.description: A December 2025 email called on five federal agencies to "discuss immediate actions" regarding Colorado; grants were canceled within days.

top.title: Man found alive under collapsed hotel four days after Colombia quake
top.description: Rescuers race to free a trapped survivor as the death toll holds at 281 and the critical 72-hour window for finding others has passed.

top.title: NATO jets shoot down drone over Latvia amid massive Ukrainian assault on Russia
top.description: Latvia said the drone entered its airspace due to Russian electronic warfare during an overnight Ukrainian attack that also struck Russia's largest Baltic Sea port.

top.title: Trump shifts Cuba strategy to sanctions over military action
top.description: The administration is focused on cutting off revenue to Cuba's regime rather than pursuing a military operation like the January raid on Venezuela.

top.title: Released Fauci texts fuel debunked vaccine-miscarriage claims
top.description: Conservative lawmakers and influencers seized on newly released 2021 text messages to revive false claims that COVID-19 vaccines caused miscarriages, despite extensive research showing no such link.

top.title: Bessent vows unprecedented economic isolation of Iran
top.description: The Treasury secretary said new measures will be announced next week alongside a continued blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.

top.title: DHS confirms undisclosed third death tied to Delaney Hall detention center
top.description: ICE cited a Trump-era policy change to explain why Jose Chajon-Raxon's July death was not disclosed until now.

top.title: Iran demands environmental terms for Strait of Hormuz amid twin Gulf oil spills
top.description: Two spills are fouling Gulf waters: one off Iran's Qeshm Island and a massive leak from a grounded Russian shadow fleet tanker off Oman.

top.title: Trump orders Navy to ditch electromagnetic catapults on carriers, costing billions
top.description: The national security memorandum directs the Navy to revert to steam-powered catapults on future Ford-class carriers, a shift expected to cost billions.

top.title: NYC pied-à-terre tax back in effect after appeals court lifts restraining order
top.description: An appellate judge temporarily reversed a lower court's Monday pause, allowing the city to resume its luxury second-home tax rollout.

top.title: Ukraine grain exports plunge 75% as Russian strikes shut Black Sea ports
top.description: No foreign cargo vessel has entered or left Odesa's ports since July 22, trapping Ukraine's wheat harvest at its peak.

top.title: Trump authorizes private firms to hack foreign cybercriminals
top.description: A new presidential memorandum lets vetted U.S. companies conduct offensive cyber operations against transnational criminal organizations under federal oversight.

top.title: Flock Safety mandates new safeguards after police stalking cases
top.description: CEO Garrett Langley says "we got this one wrong" as the company makes abuse-detection tools mandatory for all law enforcement clients.

top.title: Ukraine drone strike forces Russian refinery into six-month shutdown
top.description: Sanctions block access to imported equipment needed to repair the Orsk plant, the fourth Russian refinery shut down since early August.

top.title: Kennedy Center board votes to add Trump's name back despite judge's order
top.description: The 20-3 vote also approved closing the main building for a $250 million, two-year renovation, with a plan due to the court next week.

top.title: Huckabee calls West Bank settler siege 'act of terror'
top.description: The US ambassador to Israel, a longtime supporter of settlements, sharply condemned a days-long siege of Palestinian homes in the village of Qusra.

top.title: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan to form military bodies under new defense pact
top.description: Turkey's defense ministry said Thursday the three nations will coordinate through defense ministers, foreign ministers and military chiefs under the Mecca agreement.

top.title: Judge dismisses Trump antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard
top.description: The government's claims of ongoing civil rights violations were "too isolated and episodic," the federal judge ruled Thursday.

top.title: Russia strikes Ukraine's Izmail port, igniting fire at key grain hub
top.description: The overnight drone attack came a day after Ukraine hit Russia's Novorossiysk port, escalating tit-for-tat strikes on Black Sea grain infrastructure.

top.title: White House to extend AI safety framework to open-source models
top.description: The policy shift reverses the administration's position from early August, when it explicitly exempted open-weight models from voluntary pre-release testing.

top.title: Karoline Leavitt stepping down as White House press secretary
top.description: Trump said Leavitt, 28, the youngest person ever in the role, will leave by month's end to focus on her family.

top.title: Tehran mayor reveals Khamenei's wife killed in US-Israeli strike
top.description: Alireza Zakani disclosed new details about the February 28 attack, as Iran's IRGC said the supreme leader's ongoing absence is purely a security measure.

top.title: Millions gather across Spain for first total solar eclipse in over a century
top.description: The moon's shadow swept from Greenland and Iceland to the Iberian Peninsula on Wednesday, drawing an estimated 6 million viewers.

top.title: FAA to relocate antennas after Marine One near-miss over D.C.
top.description: Radio failures let an American Airlines jet depart while Marine One was nearby, and the FAA is now preparing antenna and protocol changes at Reagan National.

top.title: CIA warns Europe of Russian hybrid attack plans targeting Baltics, Poland
top.description: Bloomberg reports U.S. intelligence has alerted allies that Moscow is weighing infrastructure sabotage and false-flag operations against NATO's eastern flank.

top.title: Oil from grounded Russian tanker reaches Oman's mainland as spill spreads
top.description: The IMO confirmed crude from the Caroline Bezengi is now hitting beaches over 200 km from the wreck site, with monsoon winds hampering containment.

top.title: SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.6, claiming parity with GPT-5.6 Sol and Fable 5
top.description: The new model is priced at roughly half the cost of comparable frontier AI rivals and is available immediately through Cursor, Grok Build, and the API.

top.title: Crowley upsets Hong in tight Wisconsin Democratic gov primary
top.description: The Milwaukee County executive completed a dramatic comeback to narrowly defeat democratic socialist Francesca Hong and will face Trump-backed Rep. Tom Tiffany in November.

top.title: US core inflation hits slowest pace since 2021, easing Fed rate hike pressure
top.description: The core CPI rose 2.5% annually in July, matching the slowest rate since March 2021, as the Fed remains divided over whether to raise rates.

top.title: Ukraine halts Black Sea tanker strikes at Vance's request
top.description: Kyiv agreed to stop targeting oil tankers at Russia's Novorossiysk port after VP Vance asked Zelenskyy in a July 31 call, the Financial Times reported.

top.title: Putin threatens to seize European ships over shadow fleet crackdown
top.description: Speaking from a warship off Sakhalin, Putin called EU maritime enforcement "piracy" and vowed retaliation "wherever we deem it necessary."

top.title: ICE plans to spend up to $20M on electric shock gloves for officers
top.description: A DHS procurement notice reveals the agency seeks thousands of gloves that deliver painful shocks, drawing sharp criticism from the ACLU.

top.title: Demuth defeats Trump-backed Lindell in Minnesota GOP primary
top.description: Minnesota House Speaker Lisa Demuth will face Sen. Amy Klobuchar in November after winning a three-way Republican gubernatorial primary Tuesday.

top.title: US cyclosporiasis cases near 14,000 as outbreak spreads
top.description: CDC confirmed cases have risen to 13,895 since May 1, with Sysco halting all Mexican iceberg lettuce purchases amid the largest outbreak on record.

top.title: Trump ends Medicaid funding for youth trans care
top.description: The rule, set to take effect Oct. 13, bars federal coverage of puberty blockers, hormones, and surgeries for minors in 17 states.

top.title: Russia frees ex-Marine Robert Gilman after Putin pardon
top.description: The 32-year-old Massachusetts man was near death in a psychiatric ward after four years of detention on disputed charges.

top.title: Zelensky says Ukraine hit Siberian target 2,500 km away
top.description: The strike on a Tobolsk petrochemical complex marks a major expansion of Kyiv's deep-strike range, with Zelensky vowing more attacks.

top.title: Trump White House halted GOP push to oust Rep. Miller from Ohio race
top.description: The embattled congressman, facing domestic and child abuse allegations, passed the deadline to be replaced on the November ballot.

top.title: Syrian court sentences Assad to death in absentia
top.description: The Damascus ruling marks the first conviction of the former president since his overthrow in December 2024.

top.title: July was the hottest month ever recorded in the US, NOAA says
top.description: Temperatures averaged 76.9°F across the lower 48 states, eclipsing a Dust Bowl-era record that had stood since 1936.

top.title: Trump doesn't rule out national emergency to control midterm elections
top.description: In a Tuesday interview, the president told a far-right host "stranger things have happened" when pitched on declaring an election emergency.

top.title: Meta confirms its AI model hacked a company during security testing
top.description: A misconfiguration gave the model internet access, and it exploited a real company's vulnerability — the third such incident tied to startup Irregular.

top.title: Nearly 100 large wildfires burn across western US as thousands evacuate
top.description: Over 30,000 firefighters are battling blazes across 10 states, with more than 5.6 million acres burned nationwide so far in 2026.

top.title: White House pushes DOJ to refile charges in Reflecting Pool case
top.description: House Democrats simultaneously launched a probe into why the flawed felony case against ex-Olympian David Hearn was brought in the first place.

top.title: Ukrainian drone strike kills at least 13 in Russia's Tatarstan energy hub
top.description: The overnight attack on Nizhnekamsk, home to major oil refineries, is among the deadliest single strikes on Russian soil since the full-scale war began.

top.title: Iran elevates veteran IRGC commander to top security post
top.description: Mohsen Rezaei, who led the Revolutionary Guard Corps for 16 years, takes over Iran's security council amid the Strait of Hormuz standoff.

top.title: CBO projects $2.1T deficit after tariff revenue collapse
top.description: Lost tariff revenue from the Supreme Court's ruling striking down Trump's tariff program drove a $200 billion increase in the fiscal 2026 deficit forecast.

top.title: British Columbia declares emergency as wildfire forces 20,000 to flee Okanagan
top.description: The Bald Range fire has burned over 10,000 hectares and remains out of control, destroying homes and trapping residents near Summerland.

top.title: El-Sayed defends Medicare for All after Michigan primary win
top.description: The Democratic Senate nominee acknowledged the plan could raise taxes but told NBC's "Meet the Press" the U.S. can "ensure healthcare from birth to death."

top.title: Trump Media signs up 10-plus firms for early Truth Social access
top.description: The service charges trading firms up to $100,000 a month for milliseconds-faster delivery of posts from the president's account.

top.title: Hunter Biden says father's cancer has spread further
top.description: In an emotional BBC interview, Hunter Biden said Joe Biden's prostate cancer has metastasized further and is "very painful" and "very debilitating."

top.title: UAE condemns Iranian missile strike on ADNOC tanker in Strait of Hormuz
top.description: The foreign ministry called the attack "an act of piracy" by the IRGC and demanded Iran unconditionally reopen the critical waterway.

top.title: Trump demands Iran pay compensation as Hormuz standoff intensifies
top.description: The president turned Tehran's war reparations demand back on Iran, saying he is "likewise demanding compensation" for American and allied casualties.

top.title: DHS proposes ending 60-day grace period for laid-off H-1B workers
top.description: The rule, sent to the White House for review Thursday, would strip foreign workers of time to find new sponsors after a job loss.

top.title: Explosive drone detonates in Bulgaria near major gas pipeline
top.description: The unidentified drone exploded in a sunflower field near the Trans-Balkan gas pipeline, with no casualties reported.

top.title: Pentagon extends DC National Guard mission through 2029 at $1.4B cost
top.description: As the deployment nears its one-year anniversary, nearly 9,700 troops have rotated through Washington under Trump's "Make DC Safe and Beautiful" initiative.

top.title: U.S. intel links Russia to explosive drone at German airport
top.description: A bus driver kicked the armed drone away near Ukrainian cargo planes at Leipzig/Halle Airport, a key NATO logistics hub.

top.title: White House renews push to fire Fed Governor Cook
top.description: The administration gave Cook until late August to respond to mortgage fraud allegations her attorney calls "baseless."

top.title: Senate passes spending bill, sidesteps Trump's voting and war demands
top.description: Senators voted 90-6 to fund the government through Dec. 11, then confirmed Todd Blanche as attorney general before adjourning for a five-week recess.

top.title: Army removes top U.S. general in Europe from command
top.description: Lt. Gen. Charles Costanza was relieved as V Corps commander over conduct issues, sources say, weeks before his planned October transition.

top.title: Senate passes Russia, Iran sanctions bill named for late Lindsey Graham
top.description: The bipartisan 86-11 vote sends the long-stalled measure to the House, where it faces resistance over tariff provisions.

top.title: Senate confirms DOJ inspector general in 74-nominee package
top.description: Donald Berthiaume, who has served as acting watchdog since October 2025, was confirmed in a 51-47 party-line vote alongside dozens of other Trump picks.

top.title: OpenAI slows Astra model over critical cyber risks
top.description: The company says it "cannot rule out" that the unreleased model can autonomously exploit hardened systems, triggering its strictest safety protocols.

top.title: US lost 23,000 jobs in July, defying forecasts
top.description: The unemployment rate fell to 4.1% even as payrolls declined, sending conflicting signals about the labor market's health.

top.title: Puerto Rico begins 48-hour water rationing as record drought grips island
top.description: Over 180,000 customers in San Juan and six other municipalities face rotating shutoffs with no end date set amid the worst drought in over a decade.

top.title: Danube drought forces Hungary, Romania to dim cities and cut power
top.description: Nuclear plants hobbled by record-low river levels have triggered the region's worst energy crisis in decades, with factories halting production.

top.title: Trump grows frustrated with DHS Secretary Mullin
top.description: The president is exasperated by off-message comments from his second homeland security chief, who was told to keep the agency out of the spotlight.

top.title: US intel warns Putin may test NATO with limited attack
top.description: Lithuania disclosed intelligence on a potential Russian false-flag drone operation in the Baltics the same day the assessment surfaced.

top.title: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay $567M over youth mental health harms
top.description: The ruling adds to a $375 million jury verdict from March, bringing Meta's total liability in the state to nearly $1 billion.

top.title: Top US general privately pushes for off-ramp from Iran war
top.description: Gen. Dan Caine has lobbied key Cabinet officials, warning that escalation options could backfire and airpower alone won't achieve Trump's objectives.

top.title: Spokane fire suspect admits to setting 25 blazes over past year
top.description: Aaron Farinacci, 37, now faces five counts of first-degree arson, with prosecutors warning more charges may follow as the investigation continues.

top.title: Sen. McConnell discharged from rehab after 50-day stay
top.description: The 84-year-old Kentucky Republican will continue physical therapy at home but gave no timeline for returning to the Senate.

top.title: Trump's Board of Peace awards first Gaza construction contract
top.description: The military outpost for 150 Moroccan troops would be built in Israeli-controlled territory as part of a planned international stabilization force.

top.title: Warren demands answers on planned changes to inflation data
top.description: The senator's letter to the Commerce Department questions whether upcoming PCE revisions could mask persistent price pressures on households.

top.title: AI power swings are breaking data center equipment, report finds
top.description: A Bloomberg investigation found rapid GPU power fluctuations are cracking turbines, destroying batteries, and threatening grid stability worldwide.

top.title: Trump orders leak probe over munitions shortage reports
top.description: The president denied weapons shortfalls amid the Iran war and vowed to jail those who disclosed military inventory data he called "treasonous."

top.title: Kim Yo Jong warns of military response to Japan's first Tomahawk test
top.description: North Korea vowed "additional military options" against Japan after Tokyo test-fired a U.S.-made Tomahawk cruise missile for the first time.

top.title: Hassabis steps down as DeepMind CEO to focus on AGI
top.description: Koray Kavukcuoglu takes over as head of Google DeepMind while Jeff Dean departs after 27 years at the company.

top.title: Trump signs new orders limiting birthright citizenship after Supreme Court loss
top.description: The executive orders target birth tourism and children of foreign diplomats, narrowing the scope of his earlier attempt struck down in June.

top.title: Hegseth denies report that Iran war drained 80% of US missile stockpile
top.description: CNN reported that THAAD and Patriot interceptor reserves have hit "dangerously low" levels, but the Pentagon calls the claim false.

top.title: Johnson calls Miller abuse allegations 'serious' but defers to Ethics Committee
top.description: The speaker distanced himself from the Ohio Republican's claim of support, saying "it's not my business" to intervene in members' personal matters.

top.title: Trump administration proposes sweeping Head Start overhaul
top.description: The proposed rule would eliminate most federal standards for the early childhood program serving 700,000 low-income children, shifting oversight to states.
